runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 05:42 public-web sweep across 12 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade job passed ranking, language, trust/economics and locality gates; jobs-data.json therefore remains fail-closed at 52 LIVE items. LinkedIn surfaced NATEK Salesforce CRM Support Manager, full remote with quarterly Bratislava/Prague travel, but the role is senior Salesforce governance/support and outside the preferred skill level. SupportYourApp remote Europe support explicitly requires fluent English. StartupJobs surfaced MAGU Customer Care in Prague without evidence that it is executable predominantly from Slovakia, so locality remains reject/unknown rather than promotion. Upwork surfaced several worldwide VA/e-commerce/support jobs, but the strongest fits either require strong spoken/written English, have low rates (3–5 USD/h), saturated proposal/interview activity, or weak/new client confidence. Reddit current public results were FOR HIRE self-promotion rather than employer demand. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Application evidence-pack generator
developmentChanges.reason: For each high-score role, precompute a compact evidence pack mapping every stated requirement to a concrete CV/project proof, plus one honest gap. This should cut reaction time and improve reply quality without rewriting the CV blindly.

developmentChanges.title: Source query drift detector
developmentChanges.reason: Track which search phrases and source families repeatedly return irrelevant or stale inventory, then rotate query wording toward terms that actually yield eligible BA/remote candidates. This improves coverage while reducing repeated low-value scans.
